_comment: Per-class flat modifiers applied to derived stat values per [[project_class_stats_v2_locked_2026_06_14]]. Distinct from soft-cap curves (which scale stat contributions) and from engine formulas (which are class-agnostic). These are values the CLASS itself contributes -- 'the burden-bearing soul carries more vital substance' -- separate from what the stat investment buys. Added AFTER soft-cap is applied to the stat input + the engine formula computes the derived value.
_schema: Top-level key = modifier key (e.g. 'hp_offset'). Per-class sub-block = flat amount the class adds. Classes omitted from a block contribute 0 (no modifier). The Unburdened body lock at 1/1/1/1 means their modifiers fire too but their stat investment is bounded; today's Unburdened offset of 0 keeps them at the locked-floor HP per the cosmological refusal-to-install doctrine.
_v1_scope: hp_offset only. Other modifiers (stamina_offset, poise_offset, etc.) land alongside the gameplay systems that consume them per the locked authoring pattern (add modifier when the value is needed for real tuning).
